component.name: TeamCraft
component.summary: Desktop client of the TeamCraft product lifecycle management

description.p: TeamCraft is an open-source product lifecycle management (PLM) system. The desktop client connects to a TeamCraft server and works with its project groups, items, revisions, files, bills of materials and change orders.

ul.li: Check revisions out into a local workspace, edit the files with any CAD program and check them back in
See which files you changed before you check in
View STEP, mesh and point-cloud models in 3D
Review and release changes, follow notifications and checks after releases

description.p: A TeamCraft server is required; it is a separate package.
